usedFor: Routee sends texts through your Routee account, and “New contact added” starts a workflow for each new contact.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Updated” in Shopify, then “Create contact” in Routee
bestTemplate.why: The action creates a contact with name, mobile number and country code.

watchOut: “New contact added” is polling, so it runs after a scheduled check, not the moment a contact appears.
